xBadges.description:
We use OAuth2 to grant you access to our API. You can create an access token in your Infomaniak manager.
The token must then be provided in your request headers. For more information, see the Authentication page.

Required drive role of the user, the roles are set when inviting a user to the drive, and managed in the Infomaniak Manager

    • Admin: Administrator of the drive, can manage the drive (files, settings) and invite others users.
      User: Internal user can manage the files with the specified access.
      External: External user can only access the files given to them by other users.

xBadges.description:
We use OAuth2 to grant you access to our API. You can create an access token in your Infomaniak manager.
The token must then be provided in your request headers. For more information, see the Authentication page.

Required drive role of the user, the roles are set when inviting a user to the drive, and managed in the Infomaniak Manager

    • Admin: Administrator of the drive, can manage the drive (files, settings) and invite others users.
      User: Internal user can manage the files with the specified access.
      External: External user can only access the files given to them by other users.

Required file permission to access the route. The owner's file give specific permission to an user or to a team.
    • Manage: User has the write permission and can give access to the file/directory.
      Write: User has the read permission and can modify the file/directory.
      Read: User can only see the file/directory.

We use OAuth2 to grant you access to our API. You can create an access token in your Infomaniak manager.
The token must then be provided in your request headers. For more information, see the Authentication page.

Required drive role of the user, the roles are set when inviting a user to the drive, and managed in the Infomaniak Manager

    • Admin: Administrator of the drive, can manage the drive (files, settings) and invite others users.
      User: Internal user can manage the files with the specified access.
      External: External user can only access the files given to them by other users.

Required file permission to access the route. The owner's file give specific permission to an user or to a team.
    • Manage: User has the write permission and can give access to the file/directory.
      Write: User has the read permission and can modify the file/directory.
      Read: User can only see the file/directory.

xBadges.description:
We use OAuth2 to grant you access to our API. You can create an access token in your Infomaniak manager.
The token must then be provided in your request headers. For more information, see the Authentication page.

Required drive role of the user, the roles are set when inviting a user to the drive, and managed in the Infomaniak Manager

    • Admin: Administrator of the drive, can manage the drive (files, settings) and invite others users.
      User: Internal user can manage the files with the specified access.
      External: External user can only access the files given to them by other users.

Required file permission to access the route. The owner's file give specific permission to an user or to a team.
    • Manage: User has the write permission and can give access to the file/directory.
      Write: User has the read permission and can modify the file/directory.
      Read: User can only see the file/directory.

We use OAuth2 to grant you access to our API. You can create an access token in your Infomaniak manager.
The token must then be provided in your request headers. For more information, see the Authentication page.

Required drive role of the user, the roles are set when inviting a user to the drive, and managed in the Infomaniak Manager

    • Admin: Administrator of the drive, can manage the drive (files, settings) and invite others users.
      User: Internal user can manage the files with the specified access.
      External: External user can only access the files given to them by other users.

Required file permission to access the route. The owner's file give specific permission to an user or to a team.
    • Manage: User has the write permission and can give access to the file/directory.
      Write: User has the read permission and can modify the file/directory.
      Read: User can only see the file/directory.

Required file permission to access the route. The owner's file give specific permission to an user or to a team.

xBadges.description:
We use OAuth2 to grant you access to our API. You can create an access token in your Infomaniak manager.
The token must then be provided in your request headers. For more information, see the Authentication page.

Required drive role of the user, the roles are set when inviting a user to the drive, and managed in the Infomaniak Manager

    • Admin: Administrator of the drive, can manage the drive (files, settings) and invite others users.
      User: Internal user can manage the files with the specified access.
      External: External user can only access the files given to them by other users.

Required file permission to access the route. The owner's file give specific permission to an user or to a team.
    • Manage: User has the write permission and can give access to the file/directory.
      Write: User has the read permission and can modify the file/directory.
      Read: User can only see the file/directory.

No action can be made except unlocking by the application which locked the File (such as office, webdav or external import).ok: Directory V3 is available.trash_inherited: Directory V3 is currently in trash because a parent directory was trashed.trashed: Directory V3 is currently in trash and specifically trashed by the user.uploading: Directory V3 is currently being uploaded. The Directory V3 is locked and no action can be done excepting upload actions.

schema.description: The destination path of the new file. If the directory_id is provided the directory path is used as a relative path, otherwise it will be used as an absolute path. Required without directory_id.

The token must then be provided in your request headers. For more information, see the Authentication page.

      External: External user can only access the files given to them by other users.

Required file permission to access the route. The owner's file give specific permission to an user or to a team.
    • Manage: User has the write permission and can give access to the file/directory.
      Write: User has the read permission and can modify the file/directory.
      Read: User can only see the file/directory.
